title: Injection Molding Robot Technical Construction File
summary: A 185-page technical construction file and test report covering Shanghai Mengsu injection molding robot models under Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 and the standards identified in the report.

title: Injection Molding Robot Verification of Conformity
verificationBasis: Voluntary verification; not a complete CE certification
summary: Voluntary verification covering the listed MSP, MSR and MST injection molding robot models. The document itself notes that it does not imply fulfillment of every essential requirement in a Declaration of Conformity.
